record.paper_title: Open problems in local discrete holomorphic dynamics
record.original_question: Given two one-variable parabolic germs, is there an effective decision procedure for determining whether they are holomorphically locally conjugate, taking into account the multiplier, parabolic multiplicity, iterative residue, and the usually intractable functional invariants that complete the holomorphic classification?

evidence.quote: (OP4′) Give an effective procedure for deciding whether two parabolic germs are holomorphically locally conjugated.

artifact.status_search_result: No effective decision procedure for holomorphic local conjugacy of parabolic germs is known. The Écalle–Voronin classification provides a complete set of invariants (multiplier, parabolic multiplicity, iterative residue, and horn-map functional invariants), and recent work (resurgent/Borel-plane methods, numerical parabolic renormalization, realization results for Dulac germs) has produced numerical and analytic ways to access the functional invariants, but none of these yields an algorithm that decides the equivalence of horn maps. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On the resurgent approach to Écalle–Voronin's invariants
status_evidence.snippet: Écalle's alien operators ... provide each of Écalle–Voronin's invariants in the form of a convergent numerical series.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work gives convergent series representations of the invariants but does not yield a decision procedure for conjugacy.

status_evidence.title: Fixed Point of the Parabolic Renormalization Operator
status_evidence.snippet: A numerical scheme is presented for computing parabolic renormalization of a germ ... Écalle–Voronin conjugacy invariants of parabolic germs.
status_evidence.claim: Numerical methods can compute the invariants but no effective equivalence algorithm is known.

status_evidence.title: Realization of analytic moduli for parabolic Dulac germs
status_evidence.snippet: Realization results for the moduli of parabolic Dulac germs.
status_evidence.claim: Continued recent activity on the moduli of parabolic germs suggests the effective conjugacy problem remains open.
